囧.hint: Originally a pictograph of a window. Nowadays sometimes used as a sad-face emoticon.

囪.hint: Simplified form of 囱. Derived from the top component of 悤. Depicts a line piercing an object. The meaning later shifted to "window" (now written 窗) and "chimney".

园.hint: Phonosemantic compound. 囗 represents the meaning and 元 represents the sound. Simplified form of 園.

困.hint: Depicts a wooden (木) door frame (囗). Based on the original meaning "doorway, threshold". The meaning later expanded to "obstruct" and "trap".

囱.hint: Derived from the top component of 悤. Depicts a line piercing an object. The meaning later shifted to "window" (now written 窗) and "chimney".
